Definition: species code (taxonomic order) in the Stephan/Frahm/Baron system
species name as printed in Stephan, Frahm & Baron 1981
net brain volume (= sum of codes 6-10; excludes ventricles and code-4 non-brain tissues)
Note: Stephan code 5; not interchangeable with a generic whole-brain volume

Definition: medulla oblongata including the inseparable substantia reticularis assigned from the mesencephalon
cerebellum including brachium and nuclei pontis
Note: Stephan code 7; does not make a separately tabulated pons/VPo an alias

Definition: mesencephalon without substantia reticularis (the inseparable reticular portion is assigned to medulla oblongata)
diencephalon including pallidum and excluding hypophysis
Note: Stephan code 9; hypophysis is assigned to code 4

Definition: piriform lobe including palaeocortex (29) and amygdala (30) but excluding schizocortex (16)
septum including septum pellucidum, septum verum, the whole diagonal band of Broca, and bed nuclei of the anterior commissure and stria terminalis
striatum including caudate, putamen, nucleus accumbens, and internal-capsule portions running through the striatum; excludes pallidum
schizocortex: entorhinal, perirhinal, presubicular and parasubicular cortices plus underlying white matter
neocortex including underlying white matter, corpus callosum, and insular/subgenual/cingular/retrosplenial transitional cortices
area striata (primary visual cortex) including underlying white matter
Note: Stephan code 27; not equivalent to area-striata grey matter

Definition: palaeocortex including retrobulbar cortex (anterior olfactory nucleus), prepiriform cortex, lateral/medial/internal olfactory tracts, anterior commissure, olfactory tubercle, substantia innominata, and basal nucleus of Meynert
centromedial amygdaloid complex: central and medial nuclei plus anterior amygdaloid area including nucleus of lateral olfactory tract; intercalated masses assigned here
corticobasolateral amygdaloid complex: lateral, cortical and basal nuclei; basal includes accessory, magnocellular and parvocellular parts
number of individuals for the structures in that code range
